title: fix(plugin-map): refuse an unbound map instead of guessing coordinates
body:
Fixes #8169

Implements the ruling recorded on the card (director seat, decision batch #67, maintainer 「同意」, 2026-09-07): **bindings are never fabricated; an unbound surface refuses.** Option B, both faces in one PR, no staged window.

## What moved

| File | Change |
| --- | --- |
| `packages/plugin-map/src/ObjectMap.tsx` | `getMapConfig` loses its third branch — the `latitude` / `longitude` / `location` / `description` guesses — and the component gains a refusal state |
| `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` | the `locationField: … \|\| 'location'` relay floor is deleted |
| `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` | the same floor, deleted |

The refusal copy is the ruling's, verbatim:

> Map configuration required — declare `map.locationField` or `map.latitudeField` + `map.longitudeField`

It is **not** translated, and that is a decision, not an omission: `@object-ui/plugin-map` carries no `@object-ui/i18n` dependency and every user-facing string in the file is a literal, the same shape as the `Calendar configuration required` / `Gantt configuration required` refusals in the sibling plugins. Adding the dependency for one string was weighed against the ④ "don't proliferate surface" axis and not taken.

Two deliberate calls beyond the ruling's letter, both reported here rather than assumed:

1. **The refusal covers every branch, not just the unconfigured one.** A declared block that names no coordinate field (`map: { titleField: 'name' }`) and a half pair (`latitudeField` with no `longitudeField`) are just as unbound as an absent block; both used to paint an empty map under the excluded-records notice. The gate is `hasCoordinateBinding`, deliberately the same two reads `extractCoordinates` performs.
2. **The refusal sits ABOVE the `loading` / `error` gates**, for the reason objectui#8168 placed the chart's category-axis refusal above its own: it is a static authoring fact no fetch outcome changes, and a skeleton that turns into a refusal sends the author to debug the wrong layer. The fetch itself is untouched — this card changes what is rendered, not when data is fetched, and `apps/console`'s `public-block-binding-reach` probe still sees `object-map` reach the data layer.

## Premise check (PM ZONE 2)

Both mechanical assumptions were measured before any edit:

- **The two line numbers have moved**, as expected: `ListView.tsx:2673` → **2847**, `ObjectView.tsx:1468` → **1565**. The three file paths are all still correct.
- **`getMapConfig`'s third branch still had exactly the shape the ruling describes** — four field-name literals, `titleField` deliberately absent since objectui#5953, no camera. No divergence to report.
- The serial fence held: the `groupBy` / kanban path objectui#8365 owns was never touched. The `plugin-list` diff is the one `case 'map'` branch.

## Pins — all three arms the execution notes require

`packages/plugin-map/src/ObjectMap.unboundRefusal-8169.test.tsx` (7 rows):

1. an undeclared map renders the refusal state, and **replaces** the map (no `MapGL`, no markers);
2. a declared `map` block still renders markers — the control, in both the lat/lng and the `locationField` spelling;
3. ⭐ a record set carrying **real `latitude` / `longitude` columns**, on an undeclared view driven through the real `ListView`, does **not** plot — with a same-view, same-records CONTROL that declares the block and plots both.

Arm 3 is the one that measures the ruling. Arms 1 and 2 pass identically on a tree that deleted only the relay floors — the reading this card rejected, because that route widens the guess from one field name to three.

## Reverse verification

Recorded in the report on the card, and reproduced from the committed state: each face restored independently, the pins go red, restore, green again.

## Repaired pins (behaviour these tests were holding is the behaviour that changed)

- `ObjectMap.filterConfig.test.tsx` — the `0/1` pair whose `1` half proved "a DEFAULT config applies, not none" is **inverted**: the rows spelled `latitude` / `longitude` are now exactly the population that must refuse. Its style arm gets a declared binding so `MapGL` mounts at all.
- `ObjectMap.camera.test.tsx` — four camera arms declared no config and relied on the guess; they now declare the binding the records genuinely carry. Every camera number is unchanged; the file grades the camera, and the binding is now a premise.
- `ListView.mapFlatten` / `ListView.mapViewLevelConfig` / `ObjectView.mapFlatten` — the three "still emits the `locationField` default" pins are inverted to "emits no floor", each carrying the reason the two faces had to move together.

## Docs

`packages/plugin-map/README.md` and `content/docs/plugins/plugin-map.mdx` both stated the old fallback as current behaviour; both now state the refusal and the migration. The `filter.map` dev warning in `ObjectMap.tsx` said the map "renders with the DEFAULT field names" — false as of this change, repaired.

## Migration

Declare the binding: `map: { locationField: 'your_field' }`, or `map: { latitudeField, longitudeField }`. Interface pages are unaffected wherever the object actually has a location-typed field — `defaultMapFromObject` derives `locationField` from the object's own field list, which is a reading of declared metadata rather than a guess, and is untouched.
